ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_FROM_TO_DATE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION Check_From_To_date(date_from date, date_to date ) RETURN boolean IS
BEGIN
 if to_char(date_from,'YYYY-MM-DD')>
 to_char(date_to,'YYYY-MM-DD') then
 return FALSE; 
 else
 return TRUE; 
 end if; 
RETURN NULL; 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMPARISION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
Function COMPARISION (val1 varchar2, val2 varchar2)
Return number is
 answer number := 0;
Begin 
 if val1 = val2 then 
 answer := 1; 
 end if;
 return(answer); 
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) IS
 chp_sysdate DATE; 
begin

 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 
 IF :GLOBAL.tz_enabled = 'Y' THEN
 chp_sysdate := Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE);
 ELSE
 chp_sysdate := SYSDATE;
 END IF; 
 
 if from_where = 'E' then
 if trunc(eff_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('5003');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if term_date is not null and trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure; 
 end if;
 end if;
 
 if from_where = 'T' and term_date is not null then
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(eff_date) then
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if trunc(term_date) < trunc(chp_sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
end validate_dates;

ProgramUnit.Name: COMMIT_TESTS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure commit_tests is
begin

 if :system.block_status in ('NEW', 'CHANGED') then
 :system.message_level:= 20;
 COMMIT_FORM;
 :system.message_level:= 0;
 
 if form_success
 then
 show_error('0000');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 message('error in commit');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if; 
 end if;

end commit_tests;

RecordGroup.Name: LOV_RESULT
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select distinct vtr.result_status, mc.code_desc
 from valid_test_results vtr, master_codes mc
 where vtr.test_id = :valid_test_result_config.test_id
 and vtr.result_status = mc.code
 and mc.code_type = 'RESUL'

 and :ctrl_unit.chp_sysdate between vtr.eff_date and
 nvl(vtr.term_date, :ctrl_unit.chp_sysdate + 1)

RecordGroup.Name: LOV_ORDER_TEST
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select vt.test_id, vt.test_desc 
 from valid_tests vt 
where vt.test_id not in (select trc.test_id 
 from valid_test_result_config trc
 where trc.test_result_group_id = :ctrl_unit.trgid
 and :ctrl_unit.chp_sysdate between trc.eff_date and nvl(trc.term_date, :ctrl_unit.chp_sysdate+1))
 and sysdate between vt.eff_date and nvl(vt.term_date,sysdate+1)
order by vt.test_id
